metadata.current_convention: DevSim 2D device convention: every current/charge/capacitance value in this result is PER UNIT DEPTH in the unmodeled 3rd dimension (DevSim implicitly assumes 1cm of device depth out-of-plane for a 2D device) -- NOT the total value of a real device with a specific physical width. To get a real device's actual current/charge, multiply by that device's real depth in cm (e.g. a real 1um-wide device: multiply by 1e-4).
